about: Native-only text substitutions where clang rejects VC6 dialect that native_units.py cannot rewrite generically. 'source' is a src/recovered file or a src/shared header (applied to the overlay copy). Each must keep the original behaviour, and 'why' states the VC6 meaning kept (with the original address that evidences it where a choice was made). Migrate a fixup into src/ once the exact build proves the edited file still matches, then delete it here. 'renames' are applied to every source and header: qualified-name renames for VC6-only name hiding.

renames.why: Static AircraftTypeClass::Init (0x0041BEB0) hides the virtual AbstractClass::Init in VC6; see the aircraft_type.hpp fixup. Covers its definition and the qualified caller Init_Bulk_Data (0x00516900).

fixups.new: static void Init_Static_0041beb0();
fixups.why: VC6 lets the static AircraftTypeClass::Init (0x0041BEB0, rotor shapes) hide AbstractClass's virtual Init (slot 9); ISO C++ rejects a static member that overrides a virtual. Native renames the static (its definition and the one qualified caller, Init_Bulk_Data, through 'renames'); the virtual slot 9 is unchanged, as in the original vtable.

fixups.new: bool Delete(typename ra2port::delete_object_arg<T>::type object);
fixups.why: DynamicVectorClass<int>: ISO C++ finds Delete(int) / Delete(int const &) ambiguous for an int argument. VC6 takes Delete(int index) at every such call (verified inline: 0x0047D910, 0x0047D970, 0x004F9D84 HouseTypeClass::Read_INI, 0x0057C30A UnknownMapGenerator::Partition_Area all shift the vector at the argument as index, no ID call). ra2port::delete_object_arg (prelude) is T const & for every T except int, where only a user conversion reaches it, so overload resolution matches VC6.

fixups.why: Definition of the by-object Delete, same parameter spelling as vector_class_decl.hpp (see there).

WideString + wchar_t pointer on a non-const left operand: ISO ambiguity between the non-const member operator+(WideString const &) (0x0076FFA0) and the const member operator+(unsigned short const *) (0x0076FED0). VC6 calls 0x0076FED0 (0x00728690 calls 0x00771460 then 0x0076FED0 for prefix + separator + text). The overlay adds a non-const forwarder to 0x0076FED0's declaration.

typeid of a class the unit only declares: VC6 emits the type descriptor by name; ISO C++ needs the complete class. Including the class headers gives the same type identity.

Defining Int<64>'s statics needs `template<>` in ISO C++ (VC6 accepted the bare form). `{}` keeps Remainder a definition (a bare explicit specialisation would only declare it); it runs the same default constructor (XMP_Init of 64 digits).

fixups.new: template unsigned int WolDictionary<OwnerDraw::UnknownPairKey, bool>::Key_Hash(OwnerDraw::UnknownPairKey const &key) const;

The specialisation's body is the generic body token for token, so native emits an explicit instantiation of it (same code and symbol).

fixups.why: Pointer width: ATL's _GetRawUnknown adds the interface-map offset to this through int, which truncates a 64-bit pointer. Byte arithmetic on char * gives the same address VC6 computed on x86.
